resolution_algorithm: Identify logical owners needed for each capability.
Resolve owners to current physical files through the master source index and complete-owner access index.
If the current owner is bundled, resolve exact bundle, byte offset, length and hash from MANIFEST.yaml or the routed index.
Fetch the complete relevant owner and its current scoped overrides; do not fetch all files by default.
Compare evidence against the live episode state when story state changes matter.
After any authorized change, read the destination back and record its real status.
